candidates.description: Triggers when a user asks to create, update, delete, or doctor an ideal customer profile in a connected GTM context. Not for personas or managing the context repository itself.
candidates.rationale: Bare-core description with concise lifecycle triggers and neighboring artifact boundaries.

candidates.description: Triggers when a user asks to create, define, refine, update, delete, or doctor an ideal customer profile file in a connected GTM context, including choosing which organization owns it. Not for personas or for creating, importing, deleting, or repairing the context repository itself.
candidates.rationale: Adds natural define/refine language, the ownership boundary, and explicit repository-level exclusions.

candidates.description: Triggers when the requested outcome is to add, revise, remove, or validate ICP Markdown owned by an organization in an existing GTM context. Not for persona files or context-repository setup and repair.
candidates.rationale: Frames discovery around the durable ICP-file outcome while separating adjacent artifact and repository work.
